sobreNosotros.title: About Us · Floristería Rafaella
sobreNosotros.metaDescription: Learn the story of Floristería Rafaella, a neighborhood flower shop where every arrangement is handmade with love.
sobreNosotros.heading: About Floristería Rafaella
sobreNosotros.p1: Floristería Rafaella was born out of a love for flowers and for sharing special moments. What began as a passion for arranging bouquets at home became a beloved neighborhood flower shop.
sobreNosotros.p2: Every arrangement is prepared by hand, choosing the freshest flowers of the day and combining them with care so they say what you want to express: a thank you, an I love you, a hug from afar, or a see-you-soon.
sobreNosotros.p3: There's no rush here, and no assembly-line arrangements. Every customer is treated like family, and every bouquet is made thinking of the person who will receive it. That's how we've worked since day one.
sobreNosotros.quote: "Every flower carries a little piece of love."
comoPedir.title: How to Order · Floristería Rafaella
comoPedir.metaDescription: How to order from Floristería Rafaella: pick an arrangement, message us on WhatsApp, arrange delivery and get your flowers the same day.
comoPedir.heading: How to Order
comoPedir.text: Placing your order is very simple. Follow these steps and get your flowers the same day.
comoPedir.paso1.texto: Browse the catalog and pick the bouquet you like most. We can also prepare it to your taste.
comoPedir.paso2.texto: Tap the "Order via WhatsApp" button on the arrangement and the chat opens with your order already written.
comoPedir.paso3.texto: We confirm availability, address, time and payment method. All through chat, no hassle.
comoPedir.paso4.texto: We deliver the arrangement the same day within Panama City, or you can pick it up at the shop.
comoPedir.entrega.heading: Delivery and pickup
comoPedir.entrega.ciudad.texto: We deliver your arrangement the same day within Panama City (Las Acacias area and surroundings). The delivery fee depends on the zone — we'll confirm it via WhatsApp when you place your order.
comoPedir.entrega.tienda.texto: If you prefer, you can pick up your arrangement at the flower shop. Let us know via WhatsApp and we'll have it ready for you.
